value.rationale: The octagon was introduced in the literature as a canonical witness separating generalized Day--James geometry from absolute normalized norms. Its exact Banach--Mazur distance to the Euclidean plane is therefore a natural affine invariant of a named, motivated example. The result supplies a sharp global all-isomorphism certificate and an explicit optimal ellipse, making the example quantitatively reusable rather than merely recomputing a known table entry.
